original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Prove the minimum rank of arbitrary, possibly asymmetric fitting matrices for the pinned P112 required-zero graph over every characteristic-two field, with an explicit small certificate and independent checker.
scope_change_reason: The constructive helper-inventory investigation raised a necessary rank-eight label premise. This package isolates its exact obstruction as a side result; it does not supply a changed helper inventory.
bottleneck_link: Excludes replacing the fixed P112 nine-coordinate fitting labels by eight coordinates over any characteristic-two extension field, even with different source and target labels. Changed graphs, block interfaces, and complete suppliers require separate work; no kappa improvement follows.
stop_rule: Stop this side-result investigation after a source-pinned finite certificate, an elementary proof over every characteristic-two field, independent replay and explicit scope/attribution checks.
evidence: Six eight-cliques use 17 vertices and have odd incidence exactly at adjacent vertices 0 and 1. The independent standard-library verifier checks all 2912 required-zero pairs, the complete binary Gram matrix, rank-nine upper bounds, the symbolic scalar contradiction and seven corruption controls. README gives the universal proof and a separately reviewed block-rank corollary.
author: Thiago, with OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance was used for mathematical exploration, independent checking, literature search, implementation and packaging.

open_questions.question: Can a changed port graph or genuinely block-valued label interface improve a complete paid supplier budget?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The scalar rank-eight premise for this exact graph is closed. The block corollary gives only normalized rank at least 25/3, not nine, and does not price a supplier.
open_questions.first_step: Write the changed graph or block constraints and derive a complete optimistic paid budget before constructing a circuit.
open_questions.blocked_by: No compatible native word, restoration/phase proof or global owner invoice for such a changed interface is supplied here.
